visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige t-shirt and white pinafore, stands in front of a store with a red-and-white striped awning and a large sign that reads 'SEAFOOD PAN'. She waves both hands and gestures enthusiastically toward the entrance. (2) In a medium shot, the woman holds up a massive red lobster with both hands, its claws secured with yellow bands. She smiles at the camera against a neutral background. (3) A close-up shows thick, reddish-white king crab legs being grilled over charcoal; a pair of chopsticks moves a leg to show the texture. (4) The woman is shown eating a piece of sashimi with a joyful, exaggerated expression. (5) A fast montage follows, showcasing various seafood products: platters of salmon and tuna sashimi with sea urchin, a gas torch searing creamy toppings on lobster, and orange roe being poured over fish. (6) The woman stands inside a large, brightly lit warehouse-style market. A giant red decorative crab is suspended from the ceiling above her as she gestures toward the various seafood stalls. (7) Detailed close-ups of market activity: a staff member in blue gloves lifts a large live king crab; a hand dips into a tank of live shrimp; large oysters are held up to the camera for scale; and baskets of clams are shown. (8) The woman and a market employee in a black uniform hold up two bright red fish side-by-side, smiling. (9) A sequence of packaged items is shown: containers of crab, trays of uni, and vacuum-sealed beef steaks larger than a hand. (10) The woman stands behind a table overflowing with various meats and seafood in trays, gesturing with open arms toward the feast. (11) A final shot shows a variety of shrimp and crab legs sizzing on a large outdoor grill.

(2) A sharp 'pop' bubble sound effect accompanies the first visual change. (3) A bell-like 'ding' sound effect triggers as a new food item is introduced. (4) The hissing sound of a pressurized gas blowtorch is briefly heard mixed with the music. (5) Another 'pop' sound effect occurs. (6) A distinct 'ding' sound effect marks the transition to showing fresh crabs. (7) Faint sounds of splashing water and metallic baskets are audible behind the narration. (8) A percussive 'knock' or 'thud' sound occurs during the oyster segment. (9) A series of 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects continue to punctuate the fast-moving narration and visual cuts until a final bright bell chime at the end.
